verdict.rationale: Better Auth stores all auth data in the developer's own database. Its own configuration controls how long sessions last (`expiresIn`/`updateAge`, 7-day default). Logged-in users can revoke their own sessions, and API keys support custom expiration times. That gives glancing, session- and key-level retention and deletion control, but no documented user-data deletion or retention policy. missing for 10: documented user/account deletion API, configurable retention policies for user records and logs, data export/erasure (GDPR-style) tooling, independent corroboration of deletion behavior.
